title: Pennsylvania Academy of the Fine Arts

services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: PAFA Offers interactive tours for Pre-K through 12th grade students. Grounded in our collection of American art from the 18th century to the present, each tour is led by museum-trained educators and is centered on developing visual thinking skills that meet significant goals in the National Common Core curriculum standards. Tours engage students in lively, inquiry-based conversations that strengthen curriculum connections and encourage critical thinking and evidence-based reasoning skills. Experience the fun and excitement of visiting the first Art Museum and Art School in the United States. 2-hour program - $15 per studentFree admission for 1 adult* per 10 students (required), $6 each

services.name: Event Rentals
services.desc: PAFA is excited to welcome college students as part of Campus Philly CollegeFest 2026, the official welcome-to-Philadelphia week for new and returning college students across the Greater Philadelphia region. During your visit, explore PAFA's galleries, discover iconic works of American art, and experience the nation's first museum and school of fine arts. CollegeFest gives students access to free admission at participating cultural attractions throughout the city, along with transportation discounts and other special offers.
